name: blender cheat meals
instructions:
Blended full-meal soups — discovered on the liquid diet after my beard transplant. A collection of weird pureed soups that might be useful later. VARIANT A is the chicken soup version; VARIANT B is the chicken tikka masala version; VARIANT C is the tofu / red bell pepper version; VARIANT D is the blended mushroomed lentils. THIS ENTIRE RECIPE IS SCRATCH WORK — a work in progress.

=== VARIANT A — BLENDED CHICKEN SOUP ===

- SAUTÉ onion, celery, and carrot in BUTTER (butter is for flavor).
- POACH a chicken breast; PUREE it into the soup (the poaching liquid is the natural broth base).
- NO FLOUR — the blender makes roux-thickening pointless (and gummy).
- POTATO (or SWEET POTATO) + HEAVY CREAM are NECESSARY to make it a real soup — they're the body and the fat.
- HERBS: rosemary, sage, thyme, and herbes de provence are all fine here. I've done THYME + SAGE so far.
- A LOT OF LEMON JUICE — variant A needs it.
- Blend everything smooth. Salt and pepper to taste.

=== VARIANT B — BLENDED CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA ===

- Make a TOMATO MASALA — with FENNEL SEEDS instead of bay leaf (nothing that has to be fished out; see the no-fish-out rule).
- BRAISE the chicken + potato in water.
- Add LEMON JUICE.
- BLEND with COTTAGE CHEESE.

Result: great, but a little thick — see the vegan-direction note.

=== VARIANT C — TOFU / RED BELL PEPPER ===

- ROAST onions, garlic, and red bell pepper.
- Blend with FIRM TOFU.
- Seasoning: ANCHO + NEW MEXICO CHILI POWDER, the miso/nooch/porcini umami stack, and OREGANO.
- It tasted good enough to drink at this point — STOP HERE (see the mole crash note).
- NEXT TIME: LIME AND THYME, and possibly fewer glutamates — the goal is to be able to DRINK all of it, not make a soup.

=== VARIANT D — BLENDED MUSHROOMED LENTILS (INSTAPOT) ===

A blended version of the mushroomed lentils family — easy in an instapot:
1. SAUTÉ MODE: sauté the mushrooms and onion.
2. PRESSURE COOK on HIGH with dried lentils (+ liquid).
3. Throw the results in a BLENDER.
4. THICKENER: HALF A BLOCK OF EXTRA FIRM TOFU (over potato) — not as tasty as without, but it makes a VERY GOOD PROTEIN SHAKE.
notes:
=== ORIGIN — THE LIQUID DIET ===

When I got a beard transplant I had to be on a liquid diet, which involved discovering a lot of weird soups that might be useful later. This recipe collects them.

=== VARIANT A — WHAT'S STRUCTURAL ===

- BUTTER for flavor in the sauté.
- NO FLOUR: the blender does the texture work — flour has no job here.
- POTATO (OR SWEET POTATO) + HEAVY CREAM are NECESSARY — without them it's blended broth, not a real soup. They provide the starch body and the fat.
- PUREED POACHED CHICKEN BREAST is the protein — it disappears into the body of the soup.
- A LOT OF LEMON JUICE: variant A needs it — the blended cream-and-starch body reads flat without real acid.

=== VARIANT B — RESULTS + THE VEGAN DIRECTION ===

Variant B was GREAT but A LITTLE THICK. I think that's an opportunity to make a VEGAN VERSION instead: blend TOFU/CASHEW with the tikka sauce in place of the chicken/potato. Untested — the next experiment.

COTTAGE CHEESE WORKS HERE — THREE REASONS: (1) you need to balance the salt in the final mixture, and cottage cheese's saltiness does that; (2) it's higher protein than cream, and thicker; (3) western yogurt — normally the tikka marinade dairy — would be TOO SOUR here, because it isn't broiled in this format (the broil is what tames yogurt's sourness in real tikka masala). Opposite verdict from [[spinach-yogurt-smoothie]], where cottage cheese's salt clashed.

=== VARIANT C — RESULTS + THE MOLE CRASH ===

The roasted onion/garlic/bell pepper + firm tofu + chili powders + miso/nooch/porcini + oregano build TASTED GOOD ENOUGH TO DRINK. Then I flew too close to the sun: added CHOCOLATE CHIPS AND CINNAMON (experimental mole direction) and it FELL DOWN A CLIFF. Chocolate and cinnamon are clashing here.

THE LESSON: variant C wanted to be LESS SWEET/SAVORY and MORE REFRESHING. Next time: LIME AND THYME, and possibly FEWER GLUTAMATES. I might even consider CUCUMBER — a gazpacho-y direction; the roasted-pepper + cucumber + lime read points straight at it. The goal for these is DRINKABILITY — you should be able to drink all of it, not eat it as a soup. Heavy umami pushes it back toward soup.

=== VARIANT D — RESULTS ===

Very pleased with the base blend (instapot mushrooms/onion/lentils → blender). Added half a block of EXTRA FIRM TOFU to thicken it, over potato: NOT AS TASTY as without the tofu, but a very good PROTEIN SHAKE. Both forms valid — tofu-thickened when it's a shake, without when it's dinner.

=== STANDINGS + NEXT MOVES (SCRATCH WORK) ===

This entire recipe is SCRATCH WORK — a work in progress. Current standings:
- TOP TWO: the pureed chicken soup with broth (variant A) and the tofu-mushroomed-lentils (variant D).
- VARIANT B (tikka masala): would be better with TOFU AND CASHEW CREAM (instead of chicken/potato + cottage cheese).
- VARIANT C (red bell pepper tofu): would be better with a NON-SAVORY approach — maybe TOMATILLOS, CUCUMBER, BELL PEPPER.

=== NO-FISH-OUT RULE ===

Everything goes through the blender, so nothing that has to be fished out belongs in the pot — FENNEL SEEDS instead of bay leaf in the masala. Bay leaf is clashing for the collection.

=== ALL THESE SLURRIES NEED LEMON JUICE ===

I suspect basically ALL these slurries need lemon juice — confirmed in A and B both. Treat it as a collection-wide rule until a variant proves otherwise.

=== HERBS ===

Rosemary, sage, thyme, and herbes de provence are all fine. Tested so far: THYME + SAGE. (Consistent with [[french-chicken-soup]]'s sage discovery — sage and chicken broth are friends.)

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[french-chicken-soup]]: the fork-format opposite — there the broth carries discrete chunks; here everything IS the broth.
- [[chicken-pot-pie]]: the same poached-chicken + cream family in gravy form.
